note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; the major soldier, the minor soldier and the worker are described; the original “1% times” is treated as 1.5 times; synonymy, figure numbers and localities are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Distinguished from R. lamanianus and its variety angulatus by the setae on the head, thorax and abdomen; the head is narrower than in R. lamanianus var. angulatus. R. lamanianus var. australis is larger, but Fuller (1921) does not mention the vestiture. The specimens agree with Sjöstedt's (1900) descriptions of the major and minor soldiers, differing only in size: Sjöstedt recorded a major soldier head length including the mandibles of 2.2 mm and a mandible length of 0.7 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head pale yellowish brown, the sides slightly rounded, narrowed anteriorly; with several long scattered setae. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 3 1.5 times the length of segment 2. Labrum wide, anterior margin slightly rounded. Mandibles similar to those of R. lamanianus. Thorax pale yellowish brown; the anterior lobe of the pronotum with several setae, a few more scattered on the margins and the middle. Sides of the pronotum rounded, posterior margin slightly notched, anterior margin with a distinct lobe. Setae on the posterior margins of the abdominal tergites prominent. Abdomen pale yellowish brown. Measurements (mm): head length to the labral apex 2.22, head width 1.78–1.80, antennal length 2.11–2.22, pronotal length 0.64–0.66, width 1.11–1.16, hind tibia length 1.55–1.67, left mandible length 1.00–1.10. Minor soldier: head nearly oblong, the sides slightly rounded, posterior margin rounded; with a few long scattered setae. Antennae 14–15-segmented. Labrum and mandibles similar to those of R. lamanianus. Pronotum nearly oval, the posterior margin evenly rounded, a few setae scattered on the margins. Posterior margins of the abdominal tergites with long prominent setae. Measurements (mm): head length to the labral apex 1.44, head width 0.80, antennal length 1.68, pronotal length 0.38, width 0.55, hind tibia length 1.05, left mandible length 0.67.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Antennae 16-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 longer than segment 4. Head length 1.44–1.55 mm; head width 1.33 mm.
